research_disclosure_limits: Native memory_through_training_completion.peak_bytes is exact OS lifetime resident high-water through the loop boundary. It includes imports/model loading, pinned-asset verification, optimizer/input preparation and initial streaming digest; it is not isolated training allocation or peak VRAM. Setup can mask a training difference. Never subtract startup peak to claim incremental training peak.

parent_sampling.sampled_max_resident_bytes covers the entire child, including checkpoint/hash/postvalidation. Use only parent_sampling.training_interval_samples for training-interval sampled maxima. Filtered 20ms samples are lower bounds; report sample count and largest gap including loop boundaries. Cross-process monotonic clocks are shared on this supported host; sample timestamp is just after a query, so boundary membership has small query latency uncertainty.

Whole-loop wall/CPU time includes required preservation hooks, packing/retrieval, exact CE, backward, AdamW, scalar loss record/check and deadline handling. The existing activation finite-value check remains essential codec work. No reference equations/full-gradient norm or other extra diagnostic scans are timed. First-step framework/cold-cache cost and one fresh process per arm remain part of the observed implementation cost.

Auxiliary two-step fresh-process profiles deliberately include per-callback clocks/counters and per-step inventory instrumentation. They measure actual instrumented initial-state callbacks, not mean callback cost over the longer histories. Inventories are logical payload/backing-storage bookkeeping, not actual process peak; do not add per-scope union sizes without global deduplication.

Time endpoints stop at a completed atomic optimizer step and are only approximately time-matched. All six must be in [60,61] seconds and below4096step cap; actual durations, overshoots and update/token counts must be reported, with invalid pairs retained and no retry.

Exactly one local execution, three shared-book schedule scenarios and partial execution-order balancing do not give independent performance repetitions, population statistics or general device efficiency. Strict directional screens are sign screens, not effect-size tolerances, numerical equivalence or significance.

Prospectively sealed separate-book fiction-prefix NLL is a narrow natural-text fine-tuning diagnostic. Same author/series, selected prefix and possible historical pretraining exposure prevent broad/general or pretraining-clean quality claims. A lower compressed final NLL than dense still means regression if it exceeds pretrained baseline. Preserve prior synthetic regressions and fresh-state/local-update results separately.

Local dated hashes and the procedural heldout release establish the recorded workflow, not an external timestamp registry or cryptographic inability of an administrator to inspect files. Final parameter/gradient/moment finiteness/counters do not independently prove all intermediate gradients or update fidelity.
